title: Multiplicity of Laplacian eigenvalue 1 of a graph
summary: Let $G$ be a graph with $p(G)$ pendant vertices and $q(G)$ quasi-pendant vertices. Denote by $m_{L(G)}(λ)$ the multiplicity of $λ$ as a Laplacian eigenvalue of $G$. A graph $G$ is called reduced, if $p(G)=q(G)$. It is known that deleting a pendant path $P_3$ from a graph $G$ cannot change $m_{L(G)}(1)$. By the reduction operation for a graph (defined by Tian and Wong, 2026), we could turn to the reduced graphs with each quasi-pendant vertex of degree 2 to investigate $m_{L(G)}(1)$.
